title: SharpCell
summary: A free (MIT) Excel formula engine for .NET 8 and later: it reads .xlsx files, recalculates them and evaluates formulas, including dynamic arrays and LET/LAMBDA. Results are checked against workbooks calculated by Microsoft Excel.
details: Packages: `SharpCell` (the engine, no dependencies) and `SharpCell.Xlsx` (reads .xlsx). Namespaces: `SharpCell`, `SharpCell.Xlsx`. Call `Workbook.Recalculate()` after changing cells; values do not update on assignment. Excel errors are values, not exceptions. A `Workbook` is not thread-safe.
